title: Austin City Council Meeting Nov 1886
summary:
• **Low Attendance**: Only 9 of 20 aldermen showed up for the meeting, with 11 members absent

• **Brief Session**: The council had no substantive business to conduct and immediately adjourned without taking any action or discussing agenda items

• **Mayor Roberts Presiding**: Mayor J.N. Roberts led what appears to have been a largely ceremonial meeting
transcript:
A Regular meeting of the City Council.

Austin Tex November 01, 1886.
Hon. J. N. Roberts on, Mayor, presiding.

Roll Call. Present- Aldermen Brush,
Crooker, Jones, Schuber, Walker, Wellmer and Wortham- 9.
Absent- Aldermen Anderson, Caldwell, Cummings
Dedress, Ervin, Giesen, Holman, Metz,
Odell, Pillow and Schneider- 11.
adjourned On motion, the Council adjourned until the next regular meeting.
Milton Morris
City Clerk.
